title: Little Hands, Big Reach
desc: You discovered that those tiny hands of yours could actually reach out and hold things, and nothing in the world felt quite as magical as watching you figure that out. Every grab was a small victory, and we cheered for every single one.
story: It started with a moment so small we almost missed it. You were lying on your play mat, eyes fixed on the little dangling toy above you, and then, slowly and deliberately, your arm reached out and your fingers curled right around it. We froze. Then came the quiet disbelief, the kind where you look at each other without saying a word because words feel too slow for the moment. You held on with such concentration, brow slightly furrowed, as if you had been planning this all along. The toy rattled softly in your grip and you startled yourself, which made us laugh and then feel a little guilty for laughing. But you didn't let go. You held on, and that tiny act of holding felt like the whole world shifting just slightly in your favor.
